title: The 72-hour emergency kit
summary: What you need to last 3 days on your own: the official recommendation.
steps: Water: at least 6 litres per person (2 L per day).
Non-perishable food for 3 days, manual can opener.
Battery or hand-crank radio, torch or headlamp, spare batteries.
First-aid kit and usual medicines (with prescriptions).
Charged power bank and cables.
Multi-tool, whistle, lighter, space blanket.
Warm clothes, gloves, masks, toiletries.
Spare keys, cash in small notes.
Paper copies of important documents and a list of useful numbers.
What children (nappies, milk) and pets need.
tips: Check the kit every 6 months: expiry dates, batteries, power bank.
One backpack per person, ready by the door.

title: Prepare your phone before the outage
summary: What to download while the Internet still works.
steps: Download offline maps of your area (e.g. Organic Maps, OsmAnd, or Google Maps offline maps).
Install and test a messaging app that works without Internet (see “Messaging without Internet”).
Save useful documents locally (photos of ID, prescriptions).
Write important numbers down on paper.
Keep this app installed: all its content works without a network.

title: Putting together a first-aid kit
summary: The basics to treat minor injuries.
steps: Sterile compresses, plasters of various sizes, crepe bandage.
Antiseptic, saline solution.
Disposable gloves, scissors, tweezers.
Space blanket.
Paracetamol, and your personal medication for several days.
Oral rehydration salts (ORS).
Tourniquet if you are trained to use it.

title: The car emergency kit
summary: For being stuck on the road, a breakdown or an evacuation.
steps: Water (a few litres) and non-perishable snacks.
Space blankets and a warm blanket.
Headlamp and batteries.
USB charging cable and cigarette-lighter adapter.
First-aid kit.
High-visibility vest and warning triangle.
Folding shovel, ice scraper, snow chains in winter.
Jump leads.
Paper road map of the area.

title: Documents to prepare
summary: To prove your identity and get treatment when nothing is available online.
steps: Photocopies of ID cards, passports, family records.
Prescriptions, health insurance cards, vaccination records, blood group.
Insurance contracts (home, car) and their numbers.
Paper list of important numbers (family, doctor, neighbours, employer).
Spare keys.
Keep everything in a waterproof pouch in your emergency kit.
